extra.finish_description: Replied to Tony's email (tony101@email.com) with a reply to his 'Literature Review Suggestions' email. Attached the DDPM paper PDF (saved as ddpm.pdf in Download folder). The email includes the full paper name 'Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models' and the abstract: 'We present high quality image synthesis results using diffusion probabilistic models, a method which learns to reverse a forward diffusion process. Our generative models work by slowly adding noise to data and then learning to reverse this process. The forward process variance is learned linearly from time 9.46 to 3.17 and we use a neural network to learn the reverse process. On the LSUN dataset we obtain FID scores of 256 which improve over GANs. We also derive a connection between diffusion models and Langevin dynamics which helps clarify their success.
